text:
claire: quick drop 10am break photo 12 meet Binx, our office ferret who discovered a hoodie and declared it a burrow. he will not leave unless bribed with glitter pens. photo: https://imgur.com/a/binx-hoodie :ferret: :hoodie:
ben: absolute icon. also he nabbed my snack pouch. binx stop stealing engineering productivity :sob::cookie:
tasha: lost three PR stickers to the hoodie yesterday. confirmed ferret is a sticker thief. camera: `iPhone 11, Live Photo`, no flash, window light + slight crop for dramatic fluff.
reuben: facilities PSA: please keep loose snacks, lanyards, and loose badges secure. binx is a repeat lanyard taker and will hide them in soft places. :warning::id:
claire: returns policy: 1 glitter pen or 2 minutes of lap naps per sticker returned. he will accept soft compliments as partial payment.
pets-bot: Reminder: Non-service animals must be supervised in common areas. See the pets policy: https://intranet/company/pets-policy. If company property is taken, file a lost-item report with Facilities. :information_source:
ben: merch pitch: "Binx's Hoodie Heist" enamel pin. i posted a mock in #design. tasha, any sticker survivors on your desk?
tasha: found one under the couch in meeting room C. it has a tiny chew mark but it's fine. willing to trade for boop evidence + a good photo.
claire: vote: make Binx honorary weekend mascot? react with :ferret: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. tally so far: claire :ferret:, ben :ferret:, tasha :ferret:, reuben :ferret:.
reuben: logistics note: if binx visits your desk, secure cables and small electronics. he has a particular fondness for USB cords (i lost a keyboard last week). bring a carrier if you plan to transport. :grimacing::usb:
claire: fun fact: he snores like a tiny vacuum. approach quietly during deep naps. if anyone needs a morale boost, 5 min of ferret hood cuddles is available by DM. :sparkles:
ben: adding "ferret cuddle shift" to calendar as a tentative team perk 😂
claire: last note: if you see a missing sticker, check hoodie burrows first. binx takes pride in his collection.
